title: Grandma's Lake Glows After NOON 🌙
description:
My grandma's lake is free to swim in all morning. After noon, nobody goes in. The water gets warm, and something down there glows. Grandma says it's the moon, sleeping.

I'm spending the summer with her. One hot afternoon, while she napped, I jumped in anyway.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment MOON if you'd have jumped in too.
